descriptionChirho: A supernatural heavenly being sent by God, often appearing as 'angel of the LORD' (mal'akh YHWH), consistently rendered with Arabic مَلَاك/مَلَائِكَة, Korean 천사, and Swahili malaika.
A human agent sent to deliver a message, carry out a diplomatic mission, or serve as an intermediary, consistently rendered with Arabic رَسُول/رُسُل, Korean 사자/사신, and Swahili mjumbe/wajumbe.
